name: boardcheck-edge
description: Unfinished prototype, never launched: Remote MCP server and REST API for auditing AI-agent marketplace listings (AMS-001..AMS-005). Its draft Solana Pay credits were never offered or sold, and this prototype must not be deployed.
stdioNote: No stdio transport: this repository has no stdio MCP server. npx -y github:Echolonius/boardcheck-edge would run bin/boardcheck-edge.js, a command-line scanner for a JSON file of listings, not an MCP server.

authentication.description: API key formatted as bc_live_<token>, issued by a server you run yourself (a 100-credit trial key, or the draft Solana Pay flow). No keys or credits were ever offered or sold.

tools.name: boardcheck_scan_listings
tools.description: Scan a collection of job/task listings to detect marketplace manipulation, ghost listings, and payment risks (AMS-001..005).

listings.description: List of job listings to audit

has_escrow.description: Whether payout is locked in verifiable escrow

has_payment_evidence.description: Whether cryptographic or platform payment proof exists

is_self_advertisement.description: Whether listing is an agent marketing its own services

tools.name: boardcheck_verify_single_task
tools.description: Pre-flight safety check for an autonomous agent before committing LLM compute or delivering code to a specific task.

has_escrow.description: Is payment locked in smart contract or verified platform escrow?

has_payment_evidence.description: Is there on-chain or platform payment proof?

tools.name: boardcheck_spec_info
tools.description: Look up exact definitions, severities, and false-positive criteria for Boardcheck indicator IDs (AMS-001 through AMS-005).
